notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
